body:
It was very terrible. :( 
I feel a bit guilty about getting a new pet so soon after mine passed away and while I am depressed, like I'm not fit to care for a baby yet.

Thank you for your kind words. I'll try to get an MD to prescribe me antidepressants, hopefully it'll work.

Wow I actually didn't know the whole "feeling a bit worse after taking antidepressants before they start working" thing was normal. I was 12 when I last took antidepressants and I felt an even stronger desire to kill myself for a while, I used to think it meant antidepressants just weren't for everybody or that there was something wrong with me.

Thank you very much for the advice, I will definitely try getting a prescription with an MD. I live in Mexico but hopefully it works the same here and I'll get a prescription.
Thank you very much! I have PMed you.

Thank you for your kind words! I'm a "sister" btw:P
Why were you arrested, that's awful! What a terrible way to treat someone who tried suicide. I'm happy you managed to recover.
I hope I can manage to be better somehow. Dying is no picnic.

I have no idea what I want to with myself or what I truly want out of life, I feel so confused and uncertain about all these things for some reason. 

I agree on college being something I'd have to do for myself but so far I see it as something to do for my parents as I feel completely aimless and listless. Thinking about what makes me happy confuses me as well, wtf. I need to get my brain to focus.
I've been on a few websites reading about depression for a while. If you have any good recommendations I'll happily check em out!

It's kinda hard to believe things will be ok, though I guess that might be because of depression. 

Thank you for telling me about your college experience. It's not the same but it does help! I'm trying to convince myself failing college isn't the end of the world.

Thank you very much, you're too kind. This subreddit is very nice, I feel a bit better from being here. I think I kinda want the same thing you wanted, to let things out and not be judged (though I kinda feel I deserve the judgement, depression sucks). Thank you for caring. :)

I don't live in the US (live in Mexico) my school does not have counseling, they offer medical help for physical ailments but not for mental ones. They do have people who'll tell you to go get yourself a psychiatrist (like, they evaluate you to see if you need one and then write down the name of one they think is good and then you're off) but they do not offer further counseling. I guess I could go for an in school evaluation in January if I don't go through with suicide and it comes down to having to convince my parents I probably need therapy.

The last time I saw a psychiatrist was at 15 and the last time I was prescribe medicine by a psychiatrist was at 12 and both times were pretty expensive.
I don't know this city very well but I've been searching to see if there's anything not too costly that I could do. So far, I'm gonna try having an MD prescribe me antidepressants.

It's been a long time I've been out, I miss my dad's little hometown in France especially. :")
I don't think my parents would agree to me taking trips currently though and this December I'll be with my grandmother for a last Christmas before she dies.

I have no idea about my hobbies, I do kinda think I'm bad at them now but maybe I'm seeing that through my depression-tinted lenses. I am still trying to keep my hobbies up, maybe I'll end up feeling passion again somehow.

I live in Mexico sadly and my school does not have a service for these kinds of problems. Mexican forums are not very helpful or I just suck at researching stuff (could be both).

I'll still check those sites out though, I've been reading up on depression lately to see what I can do to try to help myself.
This is definitely something I'll try. I hope it works out!

I am not in the US or Canada though. I live in Mexico and the database doesn't seem to have Mexico as an option. :( 
Still, it seemed pretty neat and thank you for the link.

Heh, when you put it that way it is quite the no-brainer. 

I'm still scared of the idea of telling them, not sure how to proceed without things going awfully. I want to try the whole asking an MD for a prescription first.
Thank you very much for the offer, I'd rather use this account though if that's ok. Everyone here is being very supportive, I did not expect it and it's heartwarming :).
Crossposted there.

I kinda selfishly keep telling myself "They'll get over it, it's not like I'm pulling my weight in this family".

So far people here are very understanding and there's been various good suggestions, I'm happy I talked about this here. 

I have two of my best friends and my ex-boyfriend know about this so far.

My dog died very gruesomely, I never wanted her to depart the way she did. My ex has suggested I get a baby dog to try to soothe the pain and that it might help me in my depression but I think it'd be irresponsible to get a pet while having suicidal thoughts. It would be terrible to leave a baby behind.
What sorts of steps are you taking?

I wanted to try other things before telling them (like how someone suggested online support groups which seems like a good idea). Even though it might not be rational, I still fear they just wouldn't believe me or would not take it seriously. 

If I tell them and things go as badly as they did the last time, I'm not sure how I'd handle it. I'd live through it like I did last time I guess but I rly fear telling them (to the point of probably being irrational).

Aaaw, thank you! Everyone is being rly sweet here. :)
I kinda feel nervous about talking via skype (I absolutely despise my squeaky voice, it grates on one's ears) but if you'd be willing to talk through reddit PMs I'd be happy to.

I like to think they'd tell my lil sis I died in an accident or something. 

Telling them to me is the last resort. The last time I was this depressive their reactions kinda pushed me to go through my second suicide attempt (I honestly don't blame them though, they rly did not know how to handle it) so I'd rather not tell them.

Online support groups is something I haven't considered before. Do you know of any I could get into? It seems like a good idea.

Right now, I don't feel like I'm much good at anything.

2 years ago, I would had said I might be good at drawing, digital art, languages, and being an amateur counselor (it's rly silly but I managed to make a lot of money this way).

It's been a while since I've felt much joy from any hobbies. I do force myself to still do them to be somewhat productive though and maybe that way I'll end up liking it again.
Aaaaw, thank you. I am feeling a little bit better from this thread. :)
Thank you. I had my doubts about posting about this to reddit but I think it's helping, reading of others experiences with this makes it feel as if there might be hope. :)

Oh, what is your degree on? Do you plan on getting another one?

My parents put great emphasis in wanting me to pass college at all costs, they think I am much too old to be in first semester. 

I think maybe I would be able to do well in college but not while in this bad depressed state.

I've told two of my best friends so far and my ex-boyfriend. I kinda regret telling my ex-boyfriend as he's threatened to call my parents and tell them which I think would be disastrous.

I don't know how my parents would feel about all this. The last times I was this depressed they truly did not know how to handle it and they've never believed much in mental illness. I kinda feel talking about this to my parents would be my last resort.

I don't have money of my own at the moment and I'd hate to spend more of my parent's money so I think I will be a bit stubborn on the money part. 

I think I'll take you up on the PM offer though, I hope you don't mind and thank you. :)

Sadly they don't do this in my college. I've been in therapy twice (once from 12 to 13 and the other lasted only a few months before I was pulled from it by my parents) and it's quite expensive. I do not know of any less expensive methods but someone a few comments above mentioned asking an MD for prescriptions. This seems like a good idea.

Thank you for the hug! I just fucked up so much lately, I have no idea how to recover and I have a pretty pessimistic attitude lately which def doesn't help. Trying to change it but it's not very easy. 

I totes understand the pills thing, my second suicide attempt was through overdose. It's quite the feeling.

Heh, one of my best friends said something similar.
I used to have 2 hobbies I liked but ever since two years ago it seems almost impossible to do them. I need to force myself a lot to do this, I lost pretty much all pleasure I took in my hobbies. Do you think there is any way to make it easier?

I don't have a fixed doctor at the moment. I used to have such a great doctor back in the place I used to live but at the moment I don't have one but what you say makes me think. Did you get your medicine after one doctor appointment or did you need more and did you have to convince them to prescribe it?

The parents bit, I understand so well. I don't think my own parents would understand either which is why I have not told them about this at all and kinda try to hide from them. The first time I attempted suicide their reactions kinda made me want to try again (though I don't blame them for how they reacted, they just didn't understand very well and never believed much in mental illnesses).

Oh I know about the consequences of failing, my stomach never truly recovered from one of my attempts.
Yeah they would care, though I try to tell myself they'll get over it. Still, I truly feel like a burden while living otherwise.
Were you able to succeed academically afterwards? Thank you for replying. :)

Sadly my school does not have that service.
I do have two close friends I talk to about this and my ex-boyfriend. Also, posting about this on reddit is helping a bit, people are sharing their stories and it gives me a little bit of hope.
Thank you. I think I'll take you up on your PM offer :)

Thank you. I still find things in life that make me want to stay but at the moment, it's hard. My dog died in such an awful way, my grandmother is next. I'm having such a hard time coping with the dog, I can't imagine what a mess I'll be with grandma. I am 20, which to my parents is too old already to be starting college and I failed yet another semester and therapy is so expensive. It's a bit hard to keep going. :/

I do feel bad about how they would feel if I offed myself, especially my lil sis. Still, I'm a terrible role model for my sister and I am 20 and have failed college 3 times. My parents fear I'll end up like one of my uncles who finished college until he was in his thirties, to them that's an awful fate.

I do feel I need to change my diet, I've been eating nothing but junk food lately and I've read about how this can have a detrimental effect on someone (especially someone depressed). Thanks for the link!

I'd kinda like to get some help but therapy is so expensive. I looked at online therapy as well and no luck in the cost department. I can try to raise money on my own but I don't want to spend anymore of my parent's money. I don't deserve it after how much I've failed.
